The Department of Defense awarded CACI a $100 million contract to supply counter-unmanned aircraft system capabilities for southern border defense, a move that signals sustained federal investment in securing critical infrastructure against aerial threats [DoD awards CACI a $100 million counter-UAS contract](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivAFBVV95cUxPUlJuRXBzNFVreXdlZUgzX1p5VUxDTm9wTUdQNmVodThWdy12dGdxNkhXRXM1SWJZWHRHWGxFN1h2ZGthYlJtNkJJRjllY0cyUU5lYWp5d3ZxTlFjemQ2VGtsTFJHazVKX3dTd3NFODhLY1FjTXNCRnY4MmpuelhmZ0JMQmxMVzBSYlRsX08tUzRBdW9YMVV1N24xUGlhT0w1Qk9DSjZORnVMNl8zOTVPMUlmN2hUUDVYcjc2cQ?oc=5). This award aligns with a broader federal push to integrate counter-drone technologies, as the Federal Bureau of Investigation issued the SAFER SKIES counter-drone operations framework to provide agencies with standardized tools for managing unmanned aircraft system threats [FBI issues SAFER SKIES counter-drone operations framework](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMie0FVX3lxTFBzMFctbEV1ZFpIN1gzU09ySUc0Smk0WnQwcUYyVDFybFF1YkF0Z1VaSGtKdE92VGtQdDFCaTM1S0xGVEpubnZRRTY1aHdtUnJRcXp6Ynl5N2Joa3A2VFo0RTJGSXNhaG5EQjdnRGgxcTlzQlI5UDZkejB1Zw?oc=5). Additionally, AIRO Group announced that its RQ-35 Heidrun drone was added to the U.S. Blue UAS list, further expanding the inventory of certified systems available for government use [AIRO Group’s RQ-35 Heidrun drone added to the U.S. Blue UAS list](https://news.google.?oc=5).

Regulatory shifts are also reshaping the aviation landscape, with the Federal Aviation Administration proposing a noise-based standard to replace the decades-old ban on overland supersonic flight [FAA proposes noise-based standard to end the overland supersonic flight ban](https://news.google.?oc=5). This regulatory evolution supports new operational capabilities, as the FAA cleared a drone for avalanche-control operations in the United States [FAA clears drone for U.S. avalanche-control operations](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilwFBVV95cUxNbk9tcmo2YWEzamtBZ1lvYlpBejd2M3JQWEFrdmNxNEVWX3l0SU42QnNRR3psSTFycWdvOEc3T2F4NnZXNFBZRkoySDFpaTdUUDVIYXV6amZxZVVMR2F1UndHZmZHRW9xNGJySE1DdEpzZEhDX3EtSHZ2N0ZXTVpXVDgwelpKUGVGM1RDMy1jM3hTUC10dTNJ?oc=5). Meanwhile, a federal pilot program for electric aircraft launched in Virginia, indicating growing governmental support for sustainable aviation technologies [Federal electric-plane pilot program launches in Virginia](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqAFBVV95cUxNZ0EwM2FkdTIxQUhBVmF0ckZtNGlVbDMyaHZOWVdPanJtb2IxTWUwQXZzWVBleEtKdVRRZTQtaTZHc
